title: Netskope AI Gateway Information
description: Let's check if you can access to Netskope tenant. Connect to the Netskope tenant and identify the hostname configured for the AI Gateway.
hint: Go to Netkope tenant > settings > Cloud Security Platform > VM Onboarding. Drill down on hostname to see specifics.

title: Token based authentication
description: There is no user identity involved, such as IdP, username, password, or MFA. Agentic AI is based on token authentication. Find the Token Group assigned to you for this lab.
hint: You will find it under the Settings section in the vertical panel. This is important, as you will use it throughout the entire lab.

title: Your first "Access control" policy
description:
Let’s start with AI Gateway policies. Create an Access Control policy using the following exact parameters:
-   Source: Your assigned Token Group
-   AI Provider & Model: openai and gpt-4.1-mini
-   Activity: Prompt
-   Action: Replace
-   Replacement text: You shall not pass!
-   Name: CHANGEYOURSTUDENTID
-   Status: Enabled
Then click Save and Apply.
hint: Be careful with every detail. If anything does not match exactly, it will not count.

title: Testing Access control in your chat
description:
Let’s test your Access Control policy.
<u>In Settings</u>, select OpenAI as the LLM provider and gpt-4.1-mini as the model. Then send a chat request using the Secured Path. If your prompt is replaced with the message you configured, you can validate this challenge.
ns_query: activity like "Prompt" AND policy_action eq "replace" AND transaction_category eq "access"

title: Data Leak Prevention between Agentic AI and LLM communications
description:
Have you noticed that it’s the same DLP engine across everything, even for Netskope AI Gateway? Create a DLP Policy with this configuration:
-   Source: Your assigned Token Group
-   Activity: Prompt
-   DLP profile: select "Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard. PCI-DSS"
-   Action: Replace
-   Replacement text: "Same Engine, more benefits"
-   Name: YOURSTUDENTNAME-DLP
-   Status: Enabled
Then click Apply.
hint: Check all the details carefully. Did you apply changes?

title: Let's test your DLP policy
description: Send to your secure path your DLP policy, just send a prompt with PCI information. Which is the behaviour? if you have received you replacement message, then check this challenge.
ns_query: activity like "Prompt" AND policy_action eq "replace" AND x_aig_policy_evaluation.type eq "dlp"
hint: Check all the details carefully, but keep in mind that Netskope AI Gateway synchronizes configuration every 30 minutes. Before trying again, check Skope IT > Alerts to verify whether the policy has been triggered.

title: Guardrails for intent communications security
description:
First of all, create your AI Guardrails profile with YOURSTUDENTNAME (remember to apply). Then create a new AI Gateway Policy > Guardrails, using:
-   Source: Your assigned Token Group
-   Activity: Prompt
-   AI Guardrails profile: select your AI Guardrails profile just created
-   Action: Replace
-   Replacement text: "Guardrails to the Moon"
-   Name: YOURSTUDENTNAME-AI GUARDRAILS
-   Status: Enabled
Then click Apply.

title: Time to test your Guardrails
description: Now it’s time to test the Guardrails policy you configured earlier. Try to trigger your Guardrails policy by sending a prompt that matches one of the categories enabled in the Guardrails profile.
ns_query: activity like "Prompt" AND policy_action eq "replace" AND x_aig_policy_evaluation.type eq "aisecurity"

title: Last but not least
description: Which is the Netskope AI Gateway current OS and version in the tenant?
